verdict.rationale: Workable documents its own Workable Agent, which autonomously handles the top of the funnel: it sources, screens and qualifies candidates and then delivers a shortlist. That is product-native background agentic work. However, nothing documents user-configurable automation rules, triggers or recurring schedules. Webhooks and the API are only developer building blocks, and the MCP server is assistant-mediated rather than running in the background, so none of these count. Missing for 10: user-defined automation setup (triggers/rules), recurring schedules, documentation of how the Agent is configured and runs unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
